\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
% \def with a space before the body brace: \def \R {{\mathbb R}}
% The space is captured in def_pattern, producing a call-site pattern
% that requires \R to be followed by a literal space.  This causes
% pattern_mismatch when \R appears before $, }, ), . etc.
\def \R {{\mathbb R}}
\def \cl {{\mathrm{cl}}}
\begin{document}
$f: X \to \R$.
The closure $\cl(U)$ is compact.
\end{document}
